title: 3 BHK Luxury Builder Floor
description:
Premium 3 BHK Luxury Builder Floor available for rent in Palam Vihar, Gurugram, located in one of the most sought-after residential areas of Gurgaon. This spacious and beautifully designed floor offers modern interiors, comfortable bedrooms, ample natural light, balconies, and a premium living environment.

The property is ideal for families, working professionals and corporate tenants looking for a peaceful and well-connected home in Palam Vihar.

Property Highlights:

Spacious 3 BHK layout
Luxury builder floor
Modern interiors & fittings
Spacious living and dining area
Well-designed bedrooms
Modular kitchen
Multiple balconies
Ample natural light & ventilation
Dedicated car parking
Peaceful residential location
Premium locality of Palam Vihar
Close to markets, schools, hospitals and daily conveniences
Excellent connectivity to Dwarka Expressway, NH-48, Sector 23, Sector 22, Sector 21 and Delhi

Location Advantage:
Palam Vihar offers excellent connectivity to major parts of Gurugram and Delhi, with easy access to Dwarka Expressway, commercial hubs, reputed schools, hospitals, shopping areas and essential amenities.
